name: Ironclad Cove
summary: Deep beneath Westfall, Ironclad Cove holds a hidden shipyard and dock. The Defias Brotherhood builds its war juggernaught here, with a passage to the sea.

sections.title: The Hidden Shipyard
sections.body: Ironclad Cove lies at the deepest point of the Deadmines, where a vast sea cavern has become a fortified dockyard. Edwin VanCleef and the Defias Brotherhood have built an enormous warship here, the juggernaught. Wooden scaffolding, islets, and loading catwalks fill the cavern, watched by Defias pirates, deckhands, and overseers. VanCleef aims to do more than raid Westfall's farmsteads: he plans to assemble a private naval force capable of bombarding Stormwind's shores.

sections.title: Gateway to the Ocean
sections.body: Colossal iron-reinforced sea doors fill the cavern wall. Beyond them lies the Great Sea, along the coast of northern Stranglethorn Vale. Hidden from Stormwind's naval fleet, the cove gives the Brotherhood an unmonitored route to move contraband, stage maritime raids, and prepare its naval assault.

faq.q: What is the ship in Ironclad Cove being built for?
aliases: why is there a ship here
faq.answer: The juggernaught is the centerpiece of Edwin VanCleef's military ambitions. The Defias Brotherhood built the massive warship deep beneath the earth so it could pass unseen through subterranean water channels and strike Stormwind from the sea.

faq.q: Where does the large metal door in the cove lead?
aliases: where do the sea gates open
faq.answer: The massive gates open directly into the ocean, along the coast of northern Stranglethorn Vale. Once they open, the juggernaught can sail into the Great Sea.
The Defias Brotherhood controls Ironclad Cove under Edwin VanCleef's command. Its hidden docks keep the juggernaught's construction secret.

faq.q: Who is the murloc aboard the ship?
aliases: why is there a murloc pirate
faq.answer: The murloc is Cookie, the Defias ship's cook. Armed with a rolling pin and cooking cauldrons, he has claimed the galley as his own among the human and goblin renegades.

angles.text: Finding a full-sized war galleon buried beneath Westfall makes the Defias a military threat to the Kingdom of Stormwind, far beyond a regional bandit gang.
For a rogue, Ironclad Cove shows the height of Edwin VanCleef's craftsmanship, engineering skill, and underground logistics. Thieves and outlaws consider it legendary.
